name: HC23: Assessed for Malnutrition
description: Active ART clients assessed for malnutrition during the reporting quarter. Cross-encounter query combining ART regimen and nutrition assessment data.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce32056-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT art.client_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
WHERE art.current_arv_regimen IS NOT NULL

  AND art.client_id IN (

    WHERE nutrition_assesment IS NOT NULL
      AND encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  )", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "client", "expr": "client_id", "type": "number", "label": "Client"}, {"key": "nutrition_assesment", "expr": "nutrition_assesment", "type": "coded", "label": "Nutrition Assessment"}], "conditions": [{"key": "encounter_date", "label": "Encounter Date Range", "column": "encounter_date", "handler": "DATE_RANGE", "operator": "BETWEEN", "valueType": "date"}, {"key": "current_arv_regimen", "label": "On ART", "column": "current_arv_regimen", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "IS_NOT_NULL", "valueType": "boolean"}, {"key": "nutrition_assesment", "label": "Nutrition Assessment Documented", "column": "nutrition_assesment", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "IS_NOT_NULL", "valueType": "boolean"}], "dateColumn": "encounter_date", "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
WITH active_art_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order
        WHERE is_active_on_art = 1
          AND coverage_start_date <= :endDate
          AND (coverage_end_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY OR coverage_end_date IS NULL)
        UNION
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_return_date
        WHERE return_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND return_date <= :endDate
    ) as potential_active
    WHERE client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
        WHERE transfer_out_date IS NOT NULL AND transfer_out_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT person_id FROM person
        WHERE dead = 1 AND death_date <= :endDate
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT arv.client_id) AS total
FROM active_art_base base
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order arv ON base.client_id = arv.client_id
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_nutrition_assesment na ON arv.client_id = na.client_id
WHERE na.status IS NOT NULL
